item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["4fb401f3ca86d7e2303a","b6aa6b60dc280f699747","20d18213a89a965f9f39"],"operation":"Dispatch a strategy selected for ZSTD_compressStream2 streaming compression.","condition":"The selected strategy is excluded by the effective build configuration.","capability":"ZSTD_adjustCParams_internal and ZSTD_selectBlockCompressor must resolve it to a callable included compressor.","consequence":"Streaming compression cannot complete a successful round trip.","equivalence_reason":"All three describe the same selected-strategy dispatch and excluded-compressor fallback, with the same round-trip consequence."},{"member_ids":["078219e3c8afa5dc95ae","ce8a2495ff126b58ecfc","987d3c7a41f5b5c7a4da","e64adcb1ae5b2f60148c"],"operation":"Perform dictionary-backed streaming compression and its corresponding round trip.","condition":"A valid dictionary is supplied through supported context setup.","capability":"ZSTD_CCtx_loadDictionary or ZSTD_CCtx_refCDict must make dictionary content reachable by dictionary-aware block-compressor selection, with corresponding dictionary setup for decompression.","consequence":"The dictionary-backed streaming path cannot be exercised successfully.","equivalence_reason":"Each candidate concerns reachability of the same dictionary-loaded streaming operation through context setup."},{"member_ids":["230b08efc58f6dc3ed66","fe39deca8b68cc5b70b0"],"operation":"Run streaming compression with windowLog or hashLog above 15.","condition":"A distinct setting above 15 is supported and retained under the effective build and parameter adjustment.","capability":"FUZZ_randomCParams and ZSTD_adjustCParams_internal must allow the supported high-log setting to reach streaming compression.","consequence":"The high-log streaming configuration cannot be exercised.","equivalence_reason":"Both candidates describe the same proposed high-log configuration and the same input cap in the target."}]}
